result.scope: Synthetic single, joint, alternative, and mixed failure families with deterministic or majority-vote noisy replay.

preregistration.hypothesis: Repair-first CLM is within 0.02 repair success of the previous failure-first CLM and reduces paired mean probe calls by at least 20%.
preregistration.kill_criterion: Kill if repair-success difference is below -0.02, relative call saving is below 0.20, or the paired 95% bootstrap interval for call reduction includes zero.
